messages.subject: Some improvement ideas
parts:
I'm not sure if these ideas were suggested by somebody already, hope that I'm not the only one, who needs it.

1) Make some shared location to store files in shinyapps, so that all app instances could use it. Another option might be creating a database and simple functions for reading and writing data, which is specific to each user, so that each user has some place to store data like custom logs, for example. At the moment for every small thing, even a log file, a remote database must be used. Database might be a better option actually, as it's easier to manage locks and permissions in there and user won't need to care about it. As far as I know, R doesn't have any built-in functions that can lock a file for writing in Linux.

2) Make it possible to authenticate at the app level and group of apps level, and store login information somewhere in session$clientData, for example. Let's say I have some app or a group of apps that I use to distribute information in a usefriendly way. Each user needs to see the same gui, but the data must be filtered to contain only records relevant to a specific user. In this case ideally the user gets an authentication request when trying to access the app and I use his/her username to filter the data. I guess it's possible to do with the help of dynamic UI, but it would be so much better to have a built-in server level authentication with SSL.
